sourceEvidence.title: Senior Manager-Inventory Control
sourceEvidence.quote: Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Industrial Engineering, Aerospace Operations, or a closely related business or technical field. At least 10 years of experience in materials management, warehouse management, supply chain management, or a similar role. This must include 8+ years of progressive leadership in warehouse operations and inventory management in aerospace, defense, or commercial space launch. Knowledge of industry standards, regulations, and best practices (e.g., AS9100, OSHA, ITAR/EAR, DOT/HAZMAT). Lead and develop a multi-shift team of managers, supervisors, material handlers, and logistics staff.

requirements.quote: Lead and develop a multi-shift team of managers, supervisors, material handlers, and logistics staff. Define roles and responsibilities, cross-train across the pillar, and build a bench of talent ready to support Firefly's growing launch rate.
Knowledge of industry standards, regulations, and best practices (e.g., AS9100, OSHA, ITAR/EAR, DOT/HAZMAT). Maintain all material according to AS9100 processes, with full traceability.

Own all Firefly inventory locations as one network: the Main Manufacturing Warehouse (footprint optimization, cleanrooms, ESD limits) Launch Warehouse Locations ... Line-Side Inventory (Kanban, kitting, point-of-use replenishment)

items.notes: Degree explicitly required (Bachelor's in SCM/Logistics/IE/Aerospace Ops or related). No employer-posted base salary found in available sources (Indeed blocked; secondary aggregator used; third-party salary estimates exist but not employer-posted). Location confirmed near Bertram/Briggs TX manufacturing/launch support site. AS9100 and manufacturing ops overlap with resume competencies.

sourceEvidence.title: Senior Manager, Precision Cleaning
sourceEvidence.location: Florida (West Melbourne / Rocket Park / Space Coast)
sourceEvidence.quote: Bachelor’s degree in engineering, manufacturing, aerospace, or a related field, or equivalent military or professional experience. At least 10 years of experience in a manufacturing, aerospace, or operations environment. At least 5 years of people management experience in a manufacturing or aerospace environment, including managing managers or shift leaders and leading teams across multiple shifts. Experience with precision cleaning or chemical processing operations, such as gross and precision cleaning, degreasing, passivation, etching, and hardware cleanliness verification.

requirements.quote: At least 10 years of experience in a manufacturing, aerospace, or operations environment. At least 5 years of people management experience in a manufacturing or aerospace environment, including managing managers or shift leaders and leading teams across multiple shifts.

The Senior Manager leads Blue Origin’s Precision Cleaning Facility (PCF) at Rocket Park, a 24/7 shared service center supporting company programs. The facility provides gross cleaning, precision cleaning, chemical processing, passivation, and cleanliness verification for flight and ground hardware.

items.notes: Degree required (Bachelor’s in engineering/manufacturing/aerospace or equivalent). No employer-posted salary located in public sources. Strong manufacturing leadership and quality/process overlap. Location is Florida Space Coast / West Melbourne area.
